thesis: The public rental tape is split: marketplace 1x H100s still print cheap; committed H100/H200/B200 clusters and NVL72 offtake are scarce (SemiAnalysis Apr 2026; CoreWeave Aug 2026 sold-out after a ~25% July raise).
rank_formula: score = 0.40*liquidity + 0.35*demand + 0.25*frontier; each component 0–3. Scores are ordinal hygiene, not a valuation.
methodology: Display price is the labeled buy-now list: on-demand from the most liquid public neocloud (Lambda, else CoreWeave, else DigitalOcean). SemiAnalysis 1y is a dated series — last public period April 2026, STALE — and is never today's headline. When OD is contact-sales, a labeled spot print may be the display (B300, MI355X, MI350X). CNY prints stay CNY-primary (Ascend 910C) with a dated PBOC USD label — no guessed FX. Token/enterprise SKUs (Cerebras, Groq) carry no invented $/hour. A second venue stays in the row and is never blended into the headline number. Capacity Blocks, marketplace floors, and on-demand are incompatible terms. The term book (1m / 1q / 1y / 3y) is sourced labeled $/GPU-hr only — DigitalOcean 12-month reserved, Lambda 1-Click Clusters (labeled 1CC 2w–1y), SemiAnalysis 1y (labeled STALE), or a hyperscaler 1y/3y CUD already on the quote list. Missing tenor = em dash. We do not impute 1y = OD × 0.8 or 3y = OD × 0.65. 1M / 1Q / 1Y / 3Y percent change is computed only from two real same-venue same-term same-config dated prints (1M = 30d ±5d, 1Q = 90d ±10d, 1Y = 365d ±21d, 3Y = 1095d ±45d). Missing pair = em dash, never an invented 0%. 1h / 24h / 7d stay dashes: US list prices do not tick daily. Sparklines are step charts of dated points (carry-forward for drawing only). August 2026 figures are neocloud and hyperscaler list pages fetched this snapshot. No market-cap, no invented chips, no invented candles, no invented tenors.
display_convention: Prefer labeled on-demand from Lambda, else CoreWeave, else DigitalOcean. SA 1y is a stale second quote, never the buy-now headline. Term-book 1y prefers a current DigitalOcean 12-month reserved card, else a labeled Lambda 1-Click Cluster (2w–1y, 16-GPU row), else SA 1y (STALE), else a sourced GCP 1y. Always show at least one other venue when a second sourced print exists. Never average incompatible terms. Never use TensorWave or aggregator floors as display. Never invent a 1m / 1q / 3y US neocloud card.
term_book: Each chip carries terms: { m1, q1, y1, y3 }. A filled slot is { price, venue, term, label, as_of, url } (url may be null). A missing tenor is null — never a guessed discount off on-demand. Lead display stays the spot / on-demand buy-now print.
